groupings.title: viaSocket: 2,300+ apps, automations and AI, for you or inside your product
groupings.description: Do something in Slack, Gmail, Sheets or any of 2,300+ apps, once or every morning. Let the users of your product connect their own apps and get automations of their own. Put an AI with memory and tools in a product, add login, teams and organisations, and make a product a tool that Claude, ChatGPT and other agents use. viaSocket handles the sign-in, the tokens, the webhooks and the bills, so nothing has to be built or hosted.
